pageCache.pageTitle: Salcombe Preparatory School – Private School in Barnet, North London
pageCache.text:
Welcome to Salcombe Prep School
Nestled in North London, Salcombe Prep is a co-educational school for children aged 3–11, offering a dynamic and academically ambitious curriculum within a nurturing environment. Pupils are encouraged to think independently, ask big questions, and aim high. For over a century, academic excellence has been at our core. From our exceptional Early Years provision to outstanding 11+ results, children benefit from a rigorous, well-rounded education that builds confidence, character, and a lifelong love of learning. At Salcombe, pupils develop the courage to be wise, curious, and successful.
Proven 11+ Success
Year after year
A strong prep school education is one of the most valuable investments in a child’s long-term academic success and future opportunities. Salcombe Prep’s belief in this is reflected in our pupils outstanding 11+ results, with pupils consist-ently securing places at leading grammar and independent senior schools across London and beyond, including Aldenham, Channing, Dame Alice Owen’s, North London Collegiate, QE Boys, and The Latymer School.
Exceptional education
From day one
Across all year groups, academic outcomes consistently exceed national benchmarks — a testament to the strength of our teaching, the ambition of our curriculum, and the thorough preparation that sets our pupils up for lasting success.
Nurturing character
Through exceptional pastoral care
Empower every child to act with integrity, lead with kindness, and embrace new opportunities with confidence. Rooted in strong pastoral care, our pupils step forward with courage, speak with honesty, and support others with compassion.
Excellence Every Day
Salcombe Prep School is an exciting and inspiring place of learning where children are encouraged to achieve their academic best while developing the confidence and character to thrive in a changing world. We are committed to nurturing the whole child. Alongside strong academic foundations, we place great importance on preparing pupils for life beyond the classroom, equipping them with the skills, values and mind-set needed to embrace opportunity and meet challenge with resilience. Guided by the collective expertise of the Headteacher and Leadership Team, and underpinned by the school’s strong academic foundations, Salcombe Prep provides clear vision and purposeful leadership. Together, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment in which every child is known, valued and encouraged to excel. Curiosity is celebrated, questions are welcomed, and learning is designed to inspire every pupil to become the best version of themselves.
Salcombe Prep excels in Inspection!
In 2023, Salcombe Prep met and surpassed the standards in all five areas of ISI inspection assessment: - Leadership and management, and governance. - Quality of education, training and recreation. - Pupils’ physical and mental health and emotional wellbeing. - Pupils’ social and economic education and contribution. - Safeguarding

Ignite passion and unlock potential
At Salcombe Prep, we encourage every pupil to believe in their abilities, strive to achieve personal excellence and thrive in their academic, creative, and personal pursuits. Salcombe Prep guides pupils toward exceptional achievements, going beyond conventional education. We ignite a profound passion for learning through immersive experiences and diverse opportunities. Rooted in academic excellence, a Salcombe Prep education empowers every pupil. Regardless of the stage your child begins their educational journey with us, Salcombe Prep paves the way for success, unlocking doors to a future where they can soar to exceptional heights
OUR AIMS
Cultivate a profound appreciation for learning that extends beyond the classroom, shaping a continuous pursuit of knowledge and intellectual growth, instilling a passion for academic excellence.
Develop every pupils' self-confidence, self-esteem, and a positive, attitude towards learning and life, empowering them for a successful and fulfilling future.
Foster a culture of responsibility, care, and social consciousness, nurturing robust relationships within our school communities and beyond that celebrate diversity and respect the beliefs and perspectives of others.
Ensure every pupils' time at Salcombe Prep is enjoyable through enriching and memorable experiences, where pupils not only learn but also relish their time, fostering a positive educational journey.
Empowering uniqueness, nurturing virtue
We foster an environment that values each pupils’ uniqueness, providing opportunities for them to be celebrated. With a holistic approach, we educate the whole child, nurturing virtues and character development for thoughtful, caring, and responsible individuals.
Our commitment extends to building a positive school culture, ensuring pupils' not only enjoy their learning journey but also find it fulfilling. We actively support and positively challenge each pupil to strive for excellence, paving the way for a future where they can navigate their way and thrive in an ever-changing world with resilience.

A Unique Journey of Learning and Growth
An expansive and innovative curriculum forms the cornerstone of our educational approach, with our enriched academic and co-curricular programme providing exceptional opportunities for each child to thrive and excel.
A uniquely tailored learning experience, where we embrace the distinctiveness of each child. Our commitment to personalised learning ensures that we not only celebrate individual pupils' talents but also provide comprehensive support for their educational requirements.
Our inclusive and friendly atmosphere, creates a happy school community that feels like a family. Within this environment, we prioritise and celebrate both the wellbeing of our pupils and their academic achievements, nurturing excellence in a holistic culture.
We proudly embody a diverse and global community, fostering a multicultural environment that celebrates an array of faiths, languages, and traditions. Our inclusive spirit extends to cherishing the diverse backgrounds of all our families and staff.

Creative and Performing Arts
Cultivating creativity at Salcombe Prep
Art, Drama, and Music, hold a special place at Salcombe Prep enriching our pupil’s lives in profound ways. These subjects flourish within our school community, seamlessly integrated into both the curriculum and extra-curricular pursuits. With great care and dedication, our nurturing teachers consistently seek out new opportunities to cultivate creativity in our pupils, inspiring them to explore and embrace their unique passions.
Art
Music
Drama
Immersive art education
At Salcombe Prep, our commitment is to cultivate genuine art experiences that spark creativity in every pupil. From Pre-School to Year 2, our youngest learners embark on their artistic journey right in the comfort of their own classrooms, with teachers bringing the world of art to them. Our Prep School pupils, Year 3-6, step into our dedicated Art Studio for their weekly lessons. This purpose-built environment offers a haven for exploration and immersion, allowing pupils to fully engage with their creative pursuits. Throughout their art education, our pupils have the opportunity to experiment with a variety of mediums and delve into the works of different artists, exploring their significance within historical and global contexts.
Harmonizing music with education
Music plays an essential role in a child's cognitive development, nurturing their spirits, inspiring creativity, and providing a vital outlet amid the bustling school day. From Pre-School to Year 6, our children eagerly anticipate their weekly music sessions with our Head of Music. These lessons not only develop musical skills but also boost confidence, nurture self-esteem, and foster teamwork and imagination. In addition to scheduled classes, Salcombe Prep offers a variety of co-curricular opportunities for musical exploration. Whether joining our choir, taking individual instrumental lessons (available to pupils from Reception), or performing at our esteemed Poetry and Music recitals, there's a space for every musical soul to thrive and find fulfilment.
The world is a stage
During their time at Salcombe Prep, your child will encounter numerous opportunities to participate in various performances, ranging from class assemblies to festive plays and Year 6 production. These events provide them with the chance to showcase their talents in front of family and friends in a supportive environment. For pupils in Years 3-6 with a passion for drama, Salcombe Prep offers a Speech and Drama Club, providing an excellent opportunity to enhance their skills. The club is run by members of our teaching staff but offers pupils the option to participate in LAMDA exams, to which we have a remarkable 100% pass rate. These exams not only offer a recognised qualification but also aid pupils in developing vital communication and performance skills, which can benefit them in various aspects of life.

Careers at Salcombe Prep
Work with us
Salcombe Prep School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children. Applicants must be willing to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the job, including checks with past employers and an Enhanced Disclosure via the Disclosure & Barring Service. The job holder is responsible for promoting and safeguarding the welfare of children and young people with whom they come into contact and/or for whom they are responsible. They must adhere to and ensure compliance with the relevant Cognita Safeguarding; Child Protection Policy and Procedures at all times. If, in the course of carrying out the duties of the role, the job holder identifies any instance where a child is suffering or likely to suffer significant harm, either at school or at home, they must report any concerns to the School’s Child Protection Officer/Designated Safeguarding Lead, the Head, or the Regional CEO. This is to ensure that a referral can be made accordingly to the relevant third-party services. To view and apply for our current vacancies please visit the Cognita Careers site below:

Early Years
The start of their educational adventure
Welcome to the vibrant beginning of your child’s educational journey - the Early Years, where their adventure of discovery begins, whether it is in Pre-School or Reception. At Salcombe Prep, we pride ourselves on fostering the excitement of learning from the very start. Your child’s exploration commences at our Pre-Prep on Green Road, an English Heritage-listed building thoughtfully transformed into a haven for education. Here, their days are spent across an environment of bright, stimulating classrooms, complemented by activities outside in our eco-friendly interactive adventure zones and all-weather play surfaces.

Early Years Snapshot
Paving the way for lifelong learning
At Salcombe Prep School, our Early Years curriculum forms a sturdy educational groundwork, preparing pupils for a lifetime of learning. We are committed to providing pupils with the necessary skills and knowledge to navigate their educational journey with confidence. Central to our Early Years Curriculum are engaging and informative lessons designed to broaden children's understanding of the world and foster a love for learning. Weekly specialist sessions in Modern Foreign Languages, Music, and PE offer diverse learning experiences, enriching our pupil’s education. We prioritise English and Maths through recognised programmes that extend from Early Years right through to our Prep-School. Through various topics, we introduce fundamental mathematical concepts like number, measurement, patterns, and shape, encouraging pupils to apply Maths to real-world situations. Alongside English our topic-based approach allows an exploration of a broad range of humanities subjects which expand our learners horizon whilst strengthen their core skills.

At Salcombe Prep, we foster a deep love for literature in our children from the earliest stages of their educational journey. We carefully monitor each child's development to introduce reading materials at the optimal time. Children regularly bring home a variety of books to expand their vocabulary and engagement. They also enjoy reading to their Prep School buddies, nurturing a genuine love for storytelling. Our effective reading approach consistently exceeds national averages. Confidence-building is fundamental in our Early Years curriculum, recognising its importance in children's development.

We recognise that children learn at different rates and possess varying abilities compared to their classmates. At Salcombe Prep, we take pride in adapting our teaching and learning techniques to each child's specific needs. Our goal is to amplify their strengths, provide support in areas of difficulty, and empower them to achieve success on their own terms
Attendance and Wraparound care
Pre-School pupils are expected to participate in a minimum of five weekly sessions, which can consist of either half or full-day sessions, depending on availability. We provide wraparound care services for all pupils, allowing parents to book according to their needs and preferences.

Inspection Reports
Aiming for excellence in everything we do
Salcombe Prep is inspected by the Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI). This involves a compliance inspection every 2-3 years and a full educational quality inspection between 3-6 years.

Excelling across all 5 areas
In October 2023, Salcombe Prep underwent a comprehensive inspection by the Independent Schools Inspectorate, evaluated against the updated Framework 23 criteria. Notably, under this new framework, overall judgments or grades are no longer provided by ISI. The inspection report is structured around 5 key areas, wherein inspectors meticulously detail commendations for met standards and provide insightful overviews highlighting areas for improvement where standards are not yet met. It brings us great joy to announce that Salcombe Prep has excelled across all 5 stages, achieving a commendable "met" status in each.

Academic Excellence
Academic excellence since 1916
For over a century, Salcombe Prep has been nurturing the minds of North London's children with a steadfast commitment to academic excellence and strong values. As a non-selective independent school, we take great pride in our track record of academic achievement. Our approach emphasises personalised learning and adaptive teaching, instilling a strong work ethic that consistently yields exceptional results, setting our pupils on the path to success. We have a strong track record of supporting our pupils to secure places at their first-choice senior schools, with a significant number gaining admission to sought-after grammar schools and leading independent senior schools.
At Salcombe Prep, we are committed to upholding the highest standards in core skills. We focus on fostering excellence in reading, writing, and numeracy, providing pupils with a strong foundation to support their ongoing learning journey both in and outside of school.
Being part of a global schools group gives us unrivalled access to the latest Ed-Tech developments. Pupils from Reception to Year 1 are assigned their own school iPad and Year 3-6 pupils are issued with 1-to-1 devices.
These personalised devices are used as integral tools to enhance and transform the pupils learning experience, fostering growth and success in what is a rapidly evolving world.
We understand that all pupils learn at different rates and possess varying abilities compared to their peers. This is why we take pride in adapting our teaching and learning techniques to every pupil’s specific needs, amplifying their strengths, providing support in areas of difficulty, and empowering each pupil to believe, achieve, and thrive in their success.
At Salcombe Prep, we provide a comprehensive education that fosters all aspects of a child's development. Our curriculum is stimulating and challenging, ensuring high academic and pastoral achievements for all pupils.
Additionally, we recognise the importance of nurturing the talents of our more able and talented pupils. We offer them opportunities to excel in specific skills and talents, ensuring they reach their full potential.
Our approach
11+ Preparation
Attainment Tracking
11+ Exam Preparation
Preparation for the 11+ has always been a priority at Salcombe Prep, and a significant number of our pupils continue to secure places at leading grammar schools. With our robust 11+ curriculum, coupled with our tracking and monitoring systems, our pupils are equipped with the tools and knowledge necessary to achieve success. Our results reflect the quality of our provision. In 2024, 52% of our Year 6 cohort secured places at grammar schools for September 2024.

Attainment Tracking
Salcombe Prep is an inclusive school, and we embrace children of all abilities. Our high teaching standards drive our pupils to excel in core subjects, sports, and creative arts. We attribute our success to a rigorous process for tracking pupil progress, ensuring we have a comprehensive record of each pupil’s development. We maintain open communication with parents to address any areas where pupils need additional support. For pupils showing exceptional abilities in specific subjects, we provide challenges and support to extend their learning beyond the ordinary.
Results
We take immense pride in our pupils' academic achievements. Their success, at every level, fills us with satisfaction. While we firmly believe that a child's value cannot be measured solely by data, their skills, talents, and strengths exceed what assessments can capture. Nonetheless, our pupils consistently achieve remarkable results through their hard work. Together, we work hard to ensure every pupil sets ambitious goals, encouraging them to believe in their abilities, strive for personal excellence, and thrive in their academic, creative, and personal pursuits.
Pre-Prep and Prep School Results
In the Pre-Prep and Prep School, we celebrate academic achievements and foster a love for lifelong learning, ensuring that our pupils are prepared to embrace boundless opportunities and make a positive impact in their future endeavours. With a dedicated team of passionate educators, our nurturing environment and a well-rounded curriculum, we empower our pupils to excel academically and develop the critical skills needed to thrive in an ever-changing world. We are extremely proud of our Year 1 to Year 6 pupils’ outstanding academic achievements, as demonstrated by our GL Assessments outcomes.

Our EYFS profile results consistently surpass the national averages of 70%. By the end of the 2022/23 academic year, 84% of our Reception children achieved a Good Level of Development, with 24% exceeding this level. Digital Learning
Prepared for the future
We have a balanced approach to technology here at Salcombe Prep, using it to supplement and extend traditional teaching methods but always with an eye on children’s ‘screen time’ and supported with lessons on internet safety. Technology allows us to deliver great teaching and learning, but as a platform for collaboration and productivity. We have witnessed first-hand the positive impact it can have, putting pupils at the heart of their learning by increasing engagement, developing intrinsic interpersonal skills and preparing them for the future of adult life.
Join us for a Tour
Visit Salcombe Prep School and discover how we turn learning into an exciting adventure!
Enhancing Education: Digital Learning for Every Pupil
We’ve taken the next steps in our digital learning journey by issuing pupils in Year 3 and above with individual laptops, know to our pupils as their 1-to-1 devices!
Additionally, for our younger learners, each child from Reception to Year 2 is assigned their own school iPad, kept on-site for learning purposes. These personalised devices are used as integral tools to enhance and transform the pupils learning experience, fostering growth and success in what is a rapidly evolving world.
In a 1-to-1 environment, the learning shifts from the traditional instructor-led model to become more pupil-centred. Access to online learning tools gives the pupil options that naturally engage them and enables them to take ownership of how their learning goals are achieved. Pupils experience greater independence, greater task completion and a more efficient workflow with the ability to electronically manage and share tasks in a single environment.
Pupils can greatly benefit from 1-to-1 devices in developing their collaboration skills. These tools support essential communication and joint reasoning required for effective teamwork. By sharing a digital workspace, pupils can collaboratively create and edit content, refine each other’s contributions, and share information and ideas. Teachers enhance this process by allowing pupils to choose their communication tools and encouraging them to work together to ‘show what they know’.
1-to-1 technology makes it possible for pupils to receive differentiated content and assignments, using a variety of methods and tools. For example, pupils can pause videos and review media content multiple times. In addition to video, electronic and online resources can be selected and shared with pupils, ensuring that the content is being delivered and standards are being met, in a way that can be best understood by all pupils.
Introducing children to AI platforms, such as Century Tech and Atom, is an integral part of our digital learning program. These platforms are seamlessly integrated to enhance learning experiences, providing personalised journeys while teachers oversee the process. pageCache.pageTitle: Wellbeing and Support – Salcombe Preparatory School
pageCache.text:
Wellbeing & Support
Support to thrive
At Salcombe Prep, within our excellent pastoral care framework, we envisage every child developing the courage to seize new opportunities, exemplifying honesty in their actions, and demonstrating kindness towards others. Alongside fostering confidence to overcome challenges, we aspire to instil in them the integrity necessary to become future global citizens, leaving a positive impact on the world and flourishing in their endeavours.
Come & visit us
Visit Salcombe Prep School and discover how we turn learning into an exciting adventure!
Pastoral care takes many forms at Salcombe Prep School
At Salcombe Prep, our teachers are not just educators; they are educational storytellers, bringing learning to life through first-hand experiences both inside and outside the classroom. They ensure that pupils not only excel academically but also grow emotionally. With a commitment to closely monitoring each pupil's journey through focused assessments, our passionate staff foster academic progress and emotional wellbeing, placing the pupil at the centre of our collective focus.
We deliver a comprehensive programme of PSHE which helps pupils prepare for the pressures of the outside world. Our carefully directed programme takes into account the increasing pressures on pupils, ensuring they develop into confident, compassionate individuals who are well equipped to deal with a competitive and challenging future.
We empower all our pupils to voice their opinions. Led by representatives from each year group, the School Council established our 'Salcombe Says' rules, grounded in robust moral values. These rules provide a transparent framework for respectful behaviour, safeguarding the well-being and safety of both pupils and staff. Displayed prominently throughout the school, they foster a culture of fairness and equality in every aspect of school life.
When your child joins Salcombe Prep, it is not just them becoming part of our family - it is you too. Together, we will foster a relationship built on honesty and trust, with your child at the heart of our conversations. Our doors are always open for discussions about anything on your mind, and you are warmly invited to join us at sports fixtures, music and poetry recitals, drama productions, and a myriad of social events throughout the academic year.
Wellbeing
A fundamental element of our wellbeing offering involves maintaining a strong sense of community among our staff and pupils, fostering a true sense of family. Our school community is closely knit, where everyone, including parents, pupils, and staff, are familiar with one another. In our commitment to nurturing pupil wellbeing, we embrace the Jigsaw programme of PSHE, providing a robust foundation in personal, social, health, and emotional development through weekly lessons on emotions, behaviours, and health. Alongside these essential teachings, pupils actively engage in nationally recognised events like Odd Socks Day and Safer Internet Day, as well Cognita’s annual Global Be Well Day, where we celebrate wellbeing with our sister schools around the world.
Our commitment to the emotional wellbeing of our pupil’s is evident through various support methods.
We actively involve our pupils in shaping our well-being initiatives. This includes conducting pupil surveys (Voice of the Student) and holding school council meetings to gather their insights and feedback, ensuring that their voices are heard and valued.
As part of our Pupil Voice programme, our pupils collaboratively establish a set of guiding principles known as the Golden Rules, uniting Pre-School, Pre-Prep, and Prep. These rules not only empower each pupil to strive for their personal best but also foster character development, enabling them to become the best version of themselves.
Deliciously cooked, nutritionally balanced meals offered on-site are a cornerstone of our commitment to wellbeing. Designed by dietitians, our menus pay careful attention to accommodating vegetarians, children with allergies, and those with special dietary needs, ensuring every child is energised for success.
Safeguarding
We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. The safety of our pupils is our number one priority. View our staff list for the contact details of Salcombe Preps Safeguarding team.

Welcome to Salcombe Prep School
Nestled in North London, Salcombe Prep is a co-educational school for children aged 3–11, offering a dynamic and academically ambitious curriculum within a nurturing environment. Pupils are encouraged to think independently, ask big questions, and aim high. For over a century, academic excellence has been at our core. From our exceptional Early Years provision to outstanding 11+ results, children benefit from a rigorous, well-rounded education that builds confidence, character, and a lifelong love of learning. At Salcombe, pupils develop the courage to be wise, curious, and successful.
Proven 11+ Success
Year after year
A strong prep school education is one of the most valuable investments in a child’s long-term academic success and future opportunities. Salcombe Prep’s belief in this is reflected in our pupils outstanding 11+ results, with pupils consist-ently securing places at leading grammar and independent senior schools across London and beyond, including Aldenham, Channing, Dame Alice Owen’s, North London Collegiate, QE Boys, and The Latymer School.
Exceptional education
From day one
Across all year groups, academic outcomes consistently exceed national benchmarks — a testament to the strength of our teaching, the ambition of our curriculum, and the thorough preparation that sets our pupils up for lasting success.
Nurturing character
Through exceptional pastoral care
Empower every child to act with integrity, lead with kindness, and embrace new opportunities with confidence. Rooted in strong pastoral care, our pupils step forward with courage, speak with honesty, and support others with compassion.
Excellence Every Day
Salcombe Prep School is an exciting and inspiring place of learning where children are encouraged to achieve their academic best while developing the confidence and character to thrive in a changing world. We are committed to nurturing the whole child. Alongside strong academic foundations, we place great importance on preparing pupils for life beyond the classroom, equipping them with the skills, values and mind-set needed to embrace opportunity and meet challenge with resilience. Guided by the collective expertise of the Headteacher and Leadership Team, and underpinned by the school’s strong academic foundations, Salcombe Prep provides clear vision and purposeful leadership. Together, we foster an inclusive and supportive environment in which every child is known, valued and encouraged to excel. Curiosity is celebrated, questions are welcomed, and learning is designed to inspire every pupil to become the best version of themselves.
Salcombe Prep excels in Inspection!
In 2023, Salcombe Prep met and surpassed the standards in all five areas of ISI inspection assessment: - Leadership and management, and governance. - Quality of education, training and recreation. - Pupils’ physical and mental health and emotional wellbeing. - Pupils’ social and economic education and contribution. - Safeguarding

11+ Preparation
Mastering the 11+
Starting from Year 1, our 11+ preparation programme builds steadily, ensuring pupils are confident and fully equipped by Year 6. We instil the ability to apply knowledge effectively in both exam papers and interviews. Through termly assessments from Year 3 onwards in the core subjects and annual online evaluations, pupils refine their exam techniques. Our focus is to support each individual child and their families through the process, placing the pupil's wellbeing at the heart of our approach to both reduce stress levels and ensure success. We take pride in the many Year 6 pupils who not only excel in the 11+ but also receive offers from prestigious senior schools.
Preparing for 11+
At Salcombe Prep, we diligently prepare pupils for transition to diverse senior schools. Our curriculum reinforces essential skills, ensuring our pupils feel well-equipped for the 11+ process, as evidenced in their outcomes. We adopt a calm, holistic approach that avoids last-minute cramming. Year by year, our curriculum evolves strategically to optimize learning potential, offering both challenge and stimulation.
Through the study of Modern Foreign Languages, pupils gain a global perspective, laying strong foundations for additional language learnings.
Verbal and Non-Verbal Reasoning are integrated into the curriculum to provide a structured approach to exam preparation.
Here, the ISEB curriculum is seamlessly integrated into daily learning, enriching depth and breadth of knowledge through specialist subjects. Drama classes are introduced to instil confidence, while philosophy sessions foster critical thinking and self-expression.
Throughout Year 4, it is essential to embed and reinforce key skills crucial for a successful transition to the 11+ academic level. This journey includes an initial parent meeting with the Senior Leadership Team to explore and discuss senior school choices.
Enhanced 11+ preparation with specialised support offered at our after-school 11+ Club, including practice papers and education in exam techniques. Additionally, we continue to provide invaluable parental guidance and support to ensure a well-rounded preparation experience.
Our 11+ Club continues, providing ongoing support, coupled with regular practice papers in Verbal and Non-Verbal Reasoning, Maths and English, seamlessly integrated into both classroom activities and homework assignments.

UNDERSTANDING THE NEXT STEP
Helping our parents to prepare
At Salcombe Prep, we recognise that the decision regarding secondary schools involves numerous considerations. Not only do you want a school that is the right fit academically for your child, but there may also be financial circumstances that need to be considered as well as individual family needs. This is why we closely collaborate with each family, starting from Year 4, offering guidance and unwavering support, including personalised consultation meetings. Our ultimate goal is to ensure that every pupil not only excels academically but also finds a school that resonates with the entire family. Furthermore, our informal events, such as the Senior School Fair, provide parents with an opportunity to explore various school options in a relaxed environment. By offering these resources and support in a familiar setting, we aim to alleviate the pressure surrounding this pivotal next step in your child's education journey.

Admissions Process
Joining us is straightforward
Apply for a place at our exceptional school and give your child the best possible start to their educational journey. We have designed our admissions process to be as easy as possible and we will happily guide you every step of the way. Children can join our Pre-School class at the start of the term in which they turn 3 years old.
Our Admissions Team is on hand all year round, not just during term time, making it as easy as possible for you to get in touch, ask questions, and discover more about our school and available places. Whether you are ready to book a visit or just starting to explore, we’re here to help every step of the way.
When visiting, you can choose the option that suits you best. Book a Private Tour at a time that works for you, available throughout the year, both during term time and the school holidays. Alternatively, during term time, we host a number of Open Events. These offer a fantastic opportunity to see the school in action, meet our Senior Leadership Team, and hear directly from our pupils.
When you're ready to take the next step, register your child with us by completing this Salcombe Prep School Prep Registration Form and returning it to our Admissions Team along with a non-refundable, £120 registration fee. This will enable us to start our admission process to ensure that we can meet your child's needs. Forms need to be signed by both parents and may be returned by post, or scanned copies by email.
For Pre-School Following registration and depending on your child’s age, we will either invite you and your child to an informal assessment or to an admissions meeting with our Headmistress to discuss the offer of a place. For Reception Following registration your child will be invited into school in the Autumn Term prior to their year of entry for an informal assessment. This assessment will be followed by an admissions meeting with our Headmistress to discuss the offer of a place.
Once we receive your completed Acceptance Form and relevant deposits, we will send you confirmation of your child’s place in the school.
Chance vacancies
From time to time we do have places become available throughout the year from Reception to Year 6. Should you wish your child to be considered for one of these places we would ask that you visit the school and register your child with us. Following Registration we ask for copies of your child’s latest school reports and arrange for them to sit an age appropriate assessment in Maths and English. Once these assessments have been returned to school and marked, we will invite your child into school for a Taster Session. Please note that in ALL cases, assessments and subsequent offers are booked and made in order of application.
Early Years’ funding available
We are delighted to announce that Early Years’ funding is now available to all 3 and 4 year olds in Pre-School*. This government funding, often referred to as '15 hours free funding’, is available to every child from the term after they turn 3, and in an independent school setting. Please contact our Admissions Team directly to find out more. *Terms & conditions apply.
International Admissions Process
Salcombe Prep School holds highly trusted sponsor status with the United Kingdom Visas and Immigration (UKVI). We are able to support your child with a Tier 4 child student visa. The International Admissions Process and Fees structure differ slightly from that of domestic applicants. Please contact our International Recruitment and Admissions Team for more details.
